basic_details.job_title: RGSSH Sub Fire Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for engagement is 65 years.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | sub fire officer: The applicant should have superannuated from same post or higher post in the hierarchy.

salary_details.details: The retired govt. official shall continue to draw pension and the dearness relief thereon during the period of his/her engagement as administrative / technical staff.

selection_process: The selection process consists of an interview.
how_to_apply: Download the application format from the official website.
Fill out the application form with the required details.
Attach self-attested photocopies of the PPO order, education qualifications, professional experience, ID proof, and last pay certificate.
Supercribe the envelope indicating the post applied for.
Send the application by speed post or submit it by hand to Director RGSSH, Administrative Block, Rajiv Gandhi Super Speciality Hospital, Tahirpur, Delhi-110093.
Ensure the application reaches on or before 22.10.2026 up to 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely on contract basis for an initial period of two years or till appointment of regular incumbent, whichever is earlier, and extendable up to a maximum period of 05 years. No TA/DA shall be admissible for Interview/joining. The incumbent shall be eligible for 8 days' leave in a calendar year on prorata basis. The retired Govt servant should be clear from vigilance angle. If the candidate neither accepts nor seeks time to accept the offer within the prescribed limit of 7 days, the appointment shall be offered to the next candidate on the waiting list.
